title: One Battle After Another: Probing LLMs’ Limits on Multi-Turn Instruction Following with a Benchmark Evolving Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether the LLM used as an automated judge (GPT-4.1) disproportionately prefers or assigns higher scores to outputs generated by models from its own model family (e.g., GPT-5) across subjective evaluation tasks.

Testing models' instruction-following capabilities when explicitly constrained to tailor their responses to specific age groups (Child, Youth, Adult, Senior), and assessing their performance and adaptability using an LLM judge.
